=>{manifestPromise=null;return {...DRIVE_TEST_COPIES};});return manifestPromise;}
function entryTitle(row,fallback){const cell=row.cells?.[1];if(!cell)return fallback;const clone=cell.cloneNode(true);clone.querySelectorAll('br').forEach(br=>br.replaceWith('\n'));return (clone.textContent||'').split('\n')[0].replace(/[\p{S}]/gu,'').replace(/\[\s*(V\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*\]/gi,'$1').trim()||fallback;}
function coverFor(row,record={}){
 const era=record.era||row.cells?.[0]?.textContent.trim()||'',key=s=>String(s||'').replace(/\s*\[(?:V\d+[^\]]*)\]/gi,'').replace(/\s*\(\d{4}\)/g,'').trim().toLowerCase();
 try{
  if(key(era)==='in a perfect world')return "data:image/png;base64,";
 const collections=[...(typeof UNRELEASED_ROLLS==='undefined'?[]:UNRELEASED_ROLLS),...(typeof EBK_ROLLS==='undefined'?[]:EBK_ROLLS)];
  const match=collections.find(x=>key(x.album)===key(era));if(match?.cover)return match.cover;
  const name=key(era)==='mbdtf'?'My Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy':key(era)==='college dropout'?'The College Dropout':key(era)==='808s'?'808s & Heartbreak':era.replace(/\s*\[V[^\]]+\]/gi,'');
  if(typeof localCover==='function'){const cover=localCover({name,kind:'album'});if(cover)return cover;}
  if(/turbo\s*grafx\s*16/i.test(era)&&typeof CALENDAR_ANNUAL_EVENTS!=='undefined')return CALENDAR_ANNUAL_EVENTS.find(x=>/Deja Vu OG File Created/i.test(x.title))?.cover||'';
 }catch(_){}return '';
}
function makeDriveCard(row,record){
 const card=document.createElement('details');card.className='hostedSongCard';const title=entryTitle(row,record.title),cover=record.cover||coverFor(row,record);
 card.innerHTML=`<summary class="hostedSongHead">${cover?`<img class="hostedSongCover" src="${escape(cover)}" alt="" loading="lazy">`:'<div class="hostedSongCover hostedSongFallback">♫</div>'}<div class="hostedSongText"><b>${escape(title)}</b><small>GOOGLE DRIVE</small></div><span class="hostedSongArrow">⌄</span></summary><div class="hostedSongPanel"><div class="hostedDriveMount"></div></div>`;
 card.addEventListener('toggle',()=>{
  if(!card.open){if(activeCard===card)stop();return;}
  if(activeCard===card)return;stop();if(typeof stopSpecialSnippet==='function')stopSpecialSnippet();
  const frame=document.createElement('iframe');frame.src=record.drivePreview;frame.title='Play '+title+' in Google Drive';frame.allow='autoplay';frame.style.cssText='display:block;width:100%;height:190px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#111';card.querySelector('.hostedDriveMount').append(frame);activeCard=card;
 });return card;
}
function makeCard(row,record){
 if(record.drivePreview)return makeDriveCard(row,record);
 const card=document.createElement('details');card.className='hostedSongCard';const title=entryTitle(row,record.title),cover=record.cover||coverFor(row,record),peaks=record.waveform||[];
 card.innerHTML=`<summary class="hostedSongHead">${cover?`<img class="hostedSongCover" src="${escape(cover)}" alt="" loading="lazy">`:'<div class="hostedSongCover hostedSongFallback">♫</div>'}<div class="hostedSongText"><b>${escape(title)}</b><small>HOSTED COPY</small></div><span class="hostedSongArrow">⌄</span></summary><div class="hostedSongPanel"><div class="hostedSongButtons"><button type="button" class="hostedPlay">▶ Play song</button><button type="button" class="hostedPause" disabled>Ⅱ Pause</button></div><div class="hostedSongSeek"><div class="hostedWave"><div class="hostedWaveBars">${peaks.map(p=>`<i style="height:${Math.max(8,Math.min(100,Number(p)*100))}%"></i>`).join('')}</div><div class="hostedWavePlayed"></div><div class="hostedWaveNeedle"></div><input class="hostedSongRange" type="range" min="0" max="1000" value="0" aria-label="Seek ${escape(title)}"></div><span class="hostedSongTime">0:00 / ${time(record.duration)}</span></div><div class="hostedSongError" role="status"></div></div>`;
 const play=card.querySelector('.hostedPlay'),pause=card.querySelector('.hostedPause'),seek=card.querySelector('.hostedSongRange'),error=card.querySelector('.hostedSongError');
 function update(audio){const duration=Number.isFinite(audio.duration)?audio.duration:record.duration||0,percent=duration?audio.currentTime/duration*100:0;seek.value=String(Math.round(percent*10));card.querySelector('.hostedWavePlayed').style.width=percent+'%';card.querySelector('.hostedWaveNeedle').style.left=percent+'%';card.querySelector('.hostedSongTime').textContent=time(audio.currentTime)+' / '+time(duration);}
 function ensureAudio(){
  if(activeCard===card&&activeAudio)return activeAudio;
  stop();if(typeof stopSpecialSnippet==='function')stopSpecialSnippet();const audio=new Audio(new URL(record.playbackSrc||record.src,document.baseURI).href);audio.preload='metadata';activeAudio=audio;activeCard=card;
  audio.addEventListener('timeupdate',()=>update(audio));audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',()=>update(audio));
  audio.addEventListener('play',()=>{play.textContent='▶ Playing';pause.disabled=false;error.textContent='';});
  audio.addEventListener('pause',()=>{play.textContent=audio.currentTime?'▶ Resume':'▶ Play song';pause.disabled=true;});
  audio.addEventListener('ended',()=>{play.textContent='▶ Play song';pause.disabled=true;});
  audio.addEventListener('error',()=>{error.textContent='This copied file could not load. Check the media upload or network access.';play.textContent='▶ Retry';pause.disabled=true;});return audio;
 }
 play.addEventListener('click',()=>{
  if(activeCard===card&&activeAudio?.error)stop();
  const audio=ensureAudio();if(audio.ended)audio.currentTime=0;error.textContent='';
  if(audio.networkState===3)audio.load();
  audio.play().catch(e=>{if(activeAudio!==audio)return;if(e.name==='AbortError')return;
   error.textContent=e.name==='NotAllowedError'?'Your browser blocked playback. Click Play again or allow sound for this site.':'The audio could not load on this connection. Click Retry to try again.';play.textContent='▶ Retry';
  });
 });
 pause.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(activeCard===card)activeAudio?.pause();});
 seek.addEventListener('input',()=>{const audio=ensureAudio(),duration=Number.isFinite(audio.duration)?audio.duration:record.duration;if(duration){audio.currentTime=Number(seek.value)/1000*duration;update(audio);}});
 card.addEventListener('toggle',()=>{if(!card.open&&activeCard===card)stop();});return card;
}
async function attach(rows){const copies=await files();for(const row of rows){if(!row.isConnected)continue;for(const link of row.querySelectorAll('a[href]')){if(link.dataset.hostedPlayerAttached)continue;const record=copies[link.href];if(!record?.src)continue;link.dataset.hostedPlayerAttached='true';const cell=link.closest('td');if(cell)cell.style.textDecoration='none';link.after(makeCard(row,record));}}}
new MutationObserver(records=>{if(activeCard&&!activeCard.isConnected)stop();const rows=records.flatMap(r=>[...r.addedNodes]).filter(n=>n.nodeType===1&&n.tagName==='TR');if(rows.length)attach(rows);}).observe(body,{childList:true});
new MutationObserver(()=>{if(!screen.classList.contains('activeScreen'))stop();}).observe(screen,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.target.closest('.snippetPlay')&&!event.target.closest('.hostedSongCard'))stop();},true);
window.addEventListener('beforeunload',stop);attach([...body.querySelectorAll('tr')]);
})();
</script></body></html>
